name: card
gotchas: `mat-card-actions` left-aligns its buttons by default — use the `align="end"` input on `mat-card-actions` to right-align them instead of reaching for custom flex CSS.

`mat-card-image` (and the `mat-card-sm-image`/`mat-card-md-image`/`mat-card-lg-image` size variants) control their own cropping and aspect ratio — putting a raw `` in a card instead of one of these directives usually breaks the card's expected image sizing.

MatCard has no built-in click/ripple/focus behavior of its own — it's purely a container, so making an entire card 'clickable' means adding real interactive elements (a button or link) inside it rather than a host click listener on `mat-card`.
